1. ASHOK S/O BHUVANI PRASAD KHARE, AGED  ABOUT 60 YEARS, OCCUPATION: AGRICULTURIST

R/O VILLAGE MAHARAJPUR TEHSIL DEVRI  DISTRICT SAGAR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. BAIJNATH S/O HRIRAM KHARE, AGED ABOUT 61  YEARS, OCCUPATION: AGRICULTURIST R/O TILA  WARD DEVRI, TEHSIL DEVRI, DISTRICT SAGAR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ANUVAD SHRIVASTAVA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION DEVRI DISTRICT SAGAR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI YOGENDRA DAS YADAV - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is first application for grant of anticipatory bail under section 438 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicants who are apprehending his arrest in connection with FIR No.476/2018 registered at Police Station Devri, District Sagar for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 419, 467, 468 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicants are innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicants are a 2 MCRC-24200-2024 permanent resident of district and there is no likelihood of their absconding or tampering with prosecution evidence.
The applicants are willing and ready to abide by all the directions and conditions to be imposed by this Court.
Therefore, prayer has been made to enlarge the applicants on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

This anticipatory bail application has been argued on the ground that parties had a dispute over the property regarding which a case was filed and compromise was reached between them regarding which statement of both the sides have been recorded.

Though the complainant is not being represented in this case, but in connected case M.Cr.C. No.24178/2024, she is being represented by the counsel and her counsel has no objection in allowing the anticipatory bail application of co-accused Pratap Singh.
That accused was a signatory to a will which according to prosecution was forged by the present applicant Ashok.
Taking into consideration the fact that compromise has taken place between the parties, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicants by the police in the aforesaid crime, he shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only)each with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer) for his regular appearance before the Police/Arresting Officer during the investigation or before the Court during trial.

It is directed that the applicants shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 438(2) of Cr.P.C., failing which this order shall automatically 3 MCRC-24200-2024 stand cancelled without further reference to the Court.
Accordingly, the M.Cr.C stands allowed and disposed of.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE DevS Ashok vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51457778/
